items.title: Pay photo studio invoice
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag bitte spätestens 21 Tage nach dem Datum dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: Invoice date is 21.11.2026. The period is '21 Tage nach dem Datum dieser Rechnung' (21 days after the invoice date), a period triggered by an event, so under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts on 22.11.2026 as day 1. Day 21 of counting falls on 12.12.2026. Checking the weekday: 2026-01-01 is a Thursday, and day-of-year 346 (12 December) is (346-1) mod 7 = 2 days after Thursday = Saturday. Since 12.12.2026 is a Saturday, under §193 BGB the deadline for an act (including a payment) that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday is extended to the next business day. 13.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 14.12.2026.
